Tara (finance): Alert from the nightly ingestion: project 'experiment-shared-apac' shows $3,760 GPU cost with ~27% unlabeled rows. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/costs/2901122334 :eyes:
AlertBot: [ALERT] nightly-ingest: unlabeled_gpu_pct=26.9 project=experiment-shared-apac threshold=15% :warning:
Ben (finops): Can you paste the quick map by instance_id and sku so we can decide owners?
Tara (finance): CSV uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/fin/2901122334-experiment-unlabeled.csv. Query used:
```sql
SELECT instance_id, IFNULL((SELECT value FROM UNNEST(labels) l WHERE l.key='team'),'UNLABELED') AS team, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gcp_line_items
WHERE project_id='experiment-shared-apac' AND DATE(usage_start_time)=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY instance_id, team
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
Ravi (eng-infra): We rolled a node image migration last night; metadata agent was restarted during the window 2901118000-2901120200. That would drop labels until agents rejoined.
Sana (eng-ml): We ran a long eval sweep that spanned the exact window. I set team=exp-research in the job config but if node boot missed metadata it would show as unlabeled. I'll attach job IDs.
Marta (product): We also had two customer-facing demo sessions spun by solutions; those should be tagged sales-demo but one of the scripts is flaky.
Ben (finops): Dollar math: total $3,760, matched to job_ids = $2,500 (Sana + demos), unlabeled remainder = $1,260. Proposal: retroassign $2,500 per exact job mapping; split $1,260 70/20/10 infra/eng-ml/sales for unlabeled. Approve?
Ravi (eng-infra): Infra ok with that split but requests migration credit cap $300 for the image rollout; will submit migration-credit PR with rollout evidence.
Sana (eng-ml): Eng-ml accepts assigned share. We'll add label-retry on boot and a CI check to require --labels in job launcher. Attaching job IDs now.
Marta (product): Sales accepts the split and will fix the demo script.
Tara (finance): Confirming: finance will post ledger entries: retroassign 2901122334_experiment_shared -> assign $2,500 to teams per job mapping; ledger split for $1,260 as Ben proposed; apply migration-credit hold LH-2901122334 cap=$300 pending infra PR. Will attach CSV and PR links.
Ben (finops): I'll run the backfill query and update the ledger once evidence is attached. Also recommend adding a weekly audit for 'experiment-shared-apac' during migration windows.
AlertBot: Task TSK-5098 created: "experiment-shared-apac label-backfill + ledger" assigned to [Tara (finance),Ravi (eng-infra)].
